title: View as {name}
description: You are about to sign in as {name} at {institute}. A new tab opens with their access. Everything you do there is recorded in the audit log with your name.
otpDescription: The institute admin of {institute} has been sent a 6-digit code. Ask them for it and enter it here.
reasonTooShort: Write a reason of at least {min} characters.
otpResendTitle: Send another code to the institute admin
otpResendWait: You can ask for a new code 30 seconds after the last one
actionTitle: Open a new tab signed in as this user

errors.generic: Could not start the session. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Write a reason of at least 10 characters.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to view as this user.
errors.IMPERSONATION_TARGET_INVALID: This user cannot be viewed as: the account is inactive, has no active membership here, or holds a role equal to or above yours.
errors.IMPERSONATION_CONSENT_UNAVAILABLE: No institute admin can approve this request right now.
errors.IMPERSONATION_OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Start again.
errors.IMPERSONATION_OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many wrong codes. Start again.
errors.IMPERSONATION_SESSION_INVALID: This request is no longer valid. Start again.
